Ware]] |stunt double = [[Akos Schenek]] |special ={{SPECIAL|6,5,5,5,5,6,4}} {{Icon|FORPG}} |tag skills =Melee Weapons 2{{dot}} Small Guns 3 {{Icon|FORPG}} |level =2 {{Icon|FORPG}} }} '''Slim''' is one of two lackeys of [[Honcho]] {{In|FOTV}}. ==Background== Sometime in his life, Slim met and affiliated himself with Honcho as one of his lackeys.{{fotv|1|1}} ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The End (episode)|The End]]=== Accompanying [[Biggie]] and his boss [[Honcho]] to awaken [[the Ghoul]], he stood by Honcho and his associate Biggie, who used his [[Junk Jet (TV series)|Junk Jet]] to kill the [[Dom Pedro's guard|guard]] stationed there. Inside the compound, Slim asks Honcho where they'll find the Ghoul, and he answers that they'll search for the fresh one. At the graveyard, Honcho details to his two lackeys how [[Dom Pedro (character)|Dom Pedro]] digs up the Ghoul once a year to cut some pieces of him and then reburies him.Slim: ''"How do we know which grave?"''
[[Honcho]]: ''"Well, Slim, we look for the fresh one. Dom Pedro has our friend dug up once a year. Cuts some pieces off and puts him right back in the ground."''
({{FOTV|1|1}}) Reaching [[the Ghoul's grave]], Honcho reprimands Biggie for his remark toward the Ghoul, remarking that he's their ticket to a big payoff. Slim comments that he thought Honcho knew him. However, Honcho corrects him, stating he knew of him and claiming his pop worked with him once,Slim: ''"Shit. You're telling me this supreme badass we're looking for is a godforsaken mutant?"''
[[Honcho]]: ''"Have some respec'. That's your prospective coworker you's talking about and our ticket to a big payoff."''
Slim: ''"Thought you said you knew this guy."''
Honcho: ''"I said I knew of him. My pop worked with him once."''
({{FOTV|1|1}}) perplexing Slim, who then asks how long the Ghoul has been underground. Immediately after, Biggie opines on the possibility that the Ghoul could be [[Feral ghoul (TV series)|feral]], they're reassured by Honcho, who shows them the [[chicken]] he has in his possession. Biggie and him then dig up the Ghoul's grave with the chicken nearby and watch Honcho open it from a safe distance. Moments later, the Ghoul exits his coffin and, after gaining his composure, remarks that he's now a part of the Amish production of the Count of Monte Cristo, or it's the weirdest circle of jerks he's ever been invited to. After Honcho briefly chats with the Ghoul, they take a few steps back after the Ghoul takes an interest in the chicken and picks it up. Honcho then tries to negotiate with the Ghoul, but when the negotiations break down, Honcho threatens to have Biggie and Slim put him back into his grave. The Ghoul then eyed both Biggie and Slim and told them that when people say that when it's the last job, it typically means their hearts are not in it. Then, he remarks that it probably never was, but finishes by confessing that he does it because he loves playing the game. The Ghoul then yanked aside Honcho, used Slim as a human shield against Biggie's Junk Jet, and then used his [[Double-barrel shotgun (TV series)|double-barrel shotgun]] to blow off Biggie's head. ==Personality== Compared to his associate Biggie, Slim was more meek and mild. ==Notable quotes== * {{Inline quote|Your pop? How long's this asshole been moldering in the ground?|Slim after learning that Honcho's father knew the Ghoul}} ==Notes== The names of Honcho and his gang are descriptive of themselves. [[Honcho]] is the head honcho of the gang, [[Biggie]] is very big, and Slim is quite skinny. ==Appearances== Slim appears only {{in|FOTV}}. His gameplay statistics appear in the ''[[Fallout 2d20: NPC Pack - Hollywood Heroes]]'' expansion pack for ''[[Fallout: The Roleplaying Game]]''. {{FOTV appearances|1=101}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]] [[category:Fallout: The Roleplaying Game characters]]
